definition_km: សត្វព្រៃស៊ីសាច់មួយប្រភេទ មានរោមពណ៌ទឹកក្រូច និងឆ្នូតខ្មៅ។
definition_en: A large striped wild cat; the chaser in the game.
example_km: ខ្លារស់នៅក្នុងព្រៃធំ។
example_en: The tiger lives in the big forest.

hints.easy: It is a wild animal in the cat family.
hints.medium: It has orange fur with black stripes.
hints.strong: This animal chases the kid through the maze.

notes: Single syllable with ខ + subscript ្ល; do not split for Syllable Ordering.

definition_km: សត្វធំមួយប្រភេទ ដែលមានប្រមោយវែង។
definition_en: A very large land animal with a long trunk.
example_km: ដំរីមានប្រមោយវែង។
example_en: The elephant has a long trunk.

hints.easy: It is a very big animal.
hints.medium: It has a long trunk and big ears.
hints.strong: This 2-syllable word starts with ដំ.

definition_km: សត្វចិញ្ចឹមធំមួយប្រភេទ ជួយការងារកសិកម្ម និងផ្តល់ទឹកដោះ។
definition_en: A large farm animal kept for work, milk, or meat.
example_km: កសិករចិញ្ចឹមគោនៅភូមិ។
example_en: The farmer raises cows in the village.

hints.easy: It is a farm animal.
hints.medium: It eats grass and gives milk.
hints.strong: This 1-syllable word starts with គ.

definition_km: សត្វចិញ្ចឹមស្មោះត្រង់ ច្រើននៅជួយយាមផ្ទះ។
definition_en: A loyal domestic animal often kept as a pet or guard.
example_km: ឆ្កែរបស់ខ្ញុំរត់លឿនណាស់។
example_en: My dog runs very fast.

hints.easy: It is a common pet at home.
hints.medium: It barks and guards the house.
hints.strong: This 1-syllable word starts with ឆ្ក.

definition_km: សត្វចិញ្ចឹមតូចមួយប្រភេទ ចូលចិត្តចាប់កណ្តុរ។
definition_en: A small furry domestic animal that likes chasing mice.
example_km: ឆ្មាកំពុងដេកលើកៅអី។
example_en: The cat is sleeping on the chair.

hints.easy: It is a small pet at home.
hints.medium: It says meow and chases mice.
hints.strong: This 1-syllable word starts with ឆ្ម.

definition_km: សត្វរស់នៅក្នុងទឹក និងហែលដោយប្រើព្រុយ។
definition_en: An animal that lives and swims in water.
example_km: ត្រីហែលក្នុងទន្លេ។
example_en: Fish swim in the river.

hints.easy: It lives in the water.
hints.medium: It swims in rivers and ponds.
hints.strong: This 1-syllable word starts with ត្រ.

definition_km: សត្វស្លាបចិញ្ចឹមនៅផ្ទះ សម្រាប់ពង និងសាច់។
definition_en: A domestic farm bird raised for eggs and meat.
example_km: មាន់រងាវនៅពេលព្រឹក។
example_en: The rooster crows in the morning.

hints.easy: It is a farm bird.
hints.medium: It lays eggs and wakes people up in the morning.
hints.strong: This 1-syllable word uses Bantoc ់ at the end.

definition_km: សត្វស្លាបចេះហែលទឹក និងរស់នៅជិតទឹក។
definition_en: A water bird with a flat bill that swims well.
example_km: ទាកំពុងហែលក្នុងទឹក។
example_en: The duck is swimming in the water.

hints.easy: It is a bird that loves water.
hints.medium: It swims in ponds and quacks.
hints.strong: This short 1-syllable word starts with ទ.

definition_km: សត្វល្អិតមានស្លាបពណ៌ស្អាត ហើររកផ្កា។
definition_en: An insect with colorful wings that flies around flowers.
example_km: មេអំបៅហើរលើផ្កា។
example_en: The butterfly flies over the flower.

hints.easy: It is a flying insect.
hints.medium: It has colorful wings and visits flowers.
hints.strong: This 3-syllable word starts with មេ.

definition_km: បុរសដែលជាអ្នកបង្កើត និងថែរក្សាកូន។
definition_en: A male parent.
example_km: ឪពុករបស់ខ្ញុំទៅធ្វើការ។
example_en: My father goes to work.

hints.easy: It is a member of the family.
hints.medium: The male parent in a family.
hints.strong: This 2-syllable word starts with independent vowel ឪ.

definition_km: ស្ត្រីដែលជាអ្នកបង្កើត និងចិញ្ចឹមបីបាច់កូន។
definition_en: A female parent.
example_km: ម្តាយខ្ញុំដាំបាយរាល់ថ្ងៃ។
example_en: My mother cooks rice every day.

hints.easy: It is a parent in the family.
hints.medium: The female parent who cares for children.
hints.strong: This 1-cluster word begins with ម.

notes: Confirm dictionary preference between subscript ្ត and ្ដ; single orthographic cluster—do not split.

definition_km: អ្នកដែលកើតចេញពីឪពុកម្តាយ។
definition_en: A son, daughter, or young offspring.
example_km: កូនស្រឡាញ់ឪពុកម្តាយ។
example_en: The child loves their parents.

hints.easy: It is a family relationship word.
hints.medium: A son or daughter of parents.
hints.strong: This 1-syllable word starts with ក.

definition_km: ក្មេងតូចដែលមិនទាន់ធំពេញវ័យ។
definition_en: A young child.
example_km: កូនក្មេងលេងនៅមុខផ្ទះ។
example_en: The kid plays in front of the house.

hints.easy: It refers to a young person.
hints.medium: The young character navigating the maze.
hints.strong: This compound joins កូន and ក្មេង.

sources: General Khmer lexicon: កូនក្មេង

definition_km: អ្នកកើតមុននៅក្នុងគ្រួសារ ឬពាក្យហៅគួរសមដល់អ្នកមានអាយុច្រើនជាង។
definition_en: Older brother or sister; polite term for someone slightly older.
example_km: បងជួយបង្រៀនប្អូនអានសៀវភៅ។
example_en: The older sibling helps teach the younger sibling to read.

hints.easy: It is a family word.
hints.medium: A brother or sister who is older than you.
hints.strong: This 1-syllable word starts with ប.

definition_km: អ្នកកើតក្រោយនៅក្នុងគ្រួសារ ឬពាក្យហៅអ្នកមានអាយុតិចជាង។
definition_en: Younger brother or sister.
example_km: ប្អូនខ្ញុំទៅសាលារៀនដែរ។
example_en: My younger sibling goes to school too.

hints.easy: It is a family word.
hints.medium: A brother or sister who is younger than you.
hints.strong: This 1-syllable word starts with ប្អ.

definition_km: ឪពុករបស់ឪពុក ឬឪពុករបស់ម្តាយ។
definition_en: Grandfather; also respectful term for an elderly man.
example_km: តារបស់ខ្ញុំចូលចិត្តផឹកតែ។
example_en: My grandfather likes drinking tea.

hints.easy: It is an older family member.
hints.medium: The father of your mother or father.
hints.strong: This short 1-syllable word starts with ត.

definition_km: ម្តាយរបស់ឪពុក ឬម្តាយរបស់ម្តាយ។
definition_en: Grandmother; also respectful term for an elderly woman.
example_km: យាយទៅផ្សារទិញផ្លែឈើ។
example_en: Grandmother goes to the market to buy fruit.

hints.easy: It is an older family member.
hints.medium: The mother of your mother or father.
hints.strong: This 1-syllable word starts with យ.

definition_km: អង្ករដែលដាំឆ្អិនសម្រាប់បរិភោគ ឬអាហារប្រចាំថ្ងៃ។
definition_en: Cooked rice, or a meal in general.
example_km: គ្រួសារខ្ញុំញ៉ាំបាយពេលល្ងាច។
example_en: My family eats dinner together.

hints.easy: It is a staple food in Cambodia.
hints.medium: Cooked white grains eaten at every meal.
hints.strong: This 1-syllable word starts with ប.

definition_km: វត្ថុរាវថ្លា គ្មានពណ៌ សម្រាប់ផឹក និងប្រើប្រាស់ប្រចាំថ្ងៃ។
definition_en: Clear liquid needed for drinking and life.
example_km: យើងត្រូវផឹកទឹកស្អាតរាល់ថ្ងៃ។
example_en: We need to drink clean water every day.

hints.easy: It is something you drink.
hints.medium: It fills rivers and rain, and keeps us hydrated.
hints.strong: This 1-syllable word starts with ទ.

definition_km: ចំណីអាហារផ្អែម ឬប្រៃធ្វើពីម្សៅ។
definition_en: Cake, pastry, bread, or baked/steamed snack.
example_km: កូនក្មេងចូលចិត្តញ៉ាំនំ។
example_en: Children like eating snacks/cakes.

hints.easy: It is a sweet food or snack.
hints.medium: Often eaten at celebrations or as a treat.
hints.strong: This short 1-syllable word starts with ន.

definition_km: ផលដែលដុះចេញពីដើមឈើ សម្រាប់បរិភោគ។
definition_en: Edible sweet produce that grows on trees or plants.
example_km: ផ្លែឈើមានប្រយោជន៍ដល់សុខភាព។
example_en: Fruit is good for health.

hints.easy: It is healthy food.
hints.medium: Sweet food like mango and banana that grows on trees.
hints.strong: This compound joins ផ្លែ and ឈើ.

definition_km: រុក្ខជាតិ ស្លឹក ឬដើម សម្រាប់ធ្វើម្ហូបអាហារ។
definition_en: Edible plants or leaves used in cooking.
example_km: ម្តាយទិញបន្លែស្រស់ពីផ្សារ។
example_en: Mother buys fresh vegetables from the market.

hints.easy: It is a healthy plant food.
hints.medium: Green leaves and plants cooked with meals.
hints.strong: This word contains subscript ្ល attached to ន.

notes: 2 spoken syllables, but ្ល attaches to ន—do not split at ន្ល in Syllable Ordering.

definition_km: សាច់សត្វសម្រាប់យកមកចម្អិនជាអាហារ។
definition_en: Animal flesh eaten as food.
example_km: សាច់ត្រីមានរសជាតិឆ្ងាញ់។
example_en: Fish meat tastes delicious.

hints.easy: It is a type of food.
hints.medium: Cooked together with vegetables and rice.
hints.strong: This 1-syllable word ends with ច់.

definition_km: ភេសជ្ជៈពណ៌សដែលបានមកពីគោ ជួយឱ្យរាងកាយរឹងមាំ។
definition_en: White nutritious drink produced by cows.
example_km: សិស្សផឹកទឹកដោះគោពេលព្រឹក។
example_en: The student drinks milk in the morning.

hints.easy: It is a white drink.
hints.medium: It comes from cows and helps children grow strong.
hints.strong: This 3-part compound starts with ទឹក and ends with គោ.

sources: Wiktionary: ទឹកដោះគោ

definition_km: ផ្លែឈើរាងវែង សំបកពណ៌លឿងពេលទុំ និងមានរសជាតិផ្អែម។
definition_en: A curved fruit with yellow peel when ripe.
example_km: ដំរីចូលចិត្តស៊ីចេក។
example_en: Elephants like eating bananas.

hints.easy: It is a sweet fruit.
hints.medium: It is yellow when ripe and elephants love it.
hints.strong: This 1-syllable word starts with ច.

definition_km: ផ្លែឈើដ៏ពេញនិយមនៅកម្ពុជា មានរសជាតិជូរ ឬផ្អែម។
definition_en: A tropical fruit common in Cambodia, sour when green and sweet when ripe.
example_km: ផ្លែស្វាយទុំមានរសជាតិផ្អែម។
example_en: Ripe mangoes taste sweet.

hints.easy: It is a tropical fruit.
hints.medium: Green when unripe and sweet yellow when ripe.
hints.strong: This 2-part word starts with ផ្លែ.

sources: General Khmer lexicon: ផ្លែស្វាយ

definition_km: ផ្នែករបស់រុក្ខជាតិដែលមានពណ៌ស្អាត និងក្លិនក្រអូប។
definition_en: The colorful blossom of a plant.
example_km: ផ្កានៅក្នុងសួនច្បារស្អាតណាស់។
example_en: The flowers in the garden are very pretty.

hints.easy: It grows on plants.
hints.medium: It has bright colors and butterflies visit it.
hints.strong: This 1-syllable word starts with ផ្ក.

definition_km: រុក្ខជាតិខ្ពស់ធំ មានដើម មែក និងស្លឹក។
definition_en: A tall woody plant with a trunk, branches, and leaves.
example_km: ដើមឈើផ្តល់ម្លប់ត្រជាក់។
example_en: Trees provide cool shade.

hints.easy: It is a large plant.
hints.medium: It has a trunk, leaves, and gives shade.
hints.strong: This 2-syllable compound starts with ដើម.

definition_km: ទីកន្លែងដែលមានដើមឈើដុះច្រើន និងជាជម្រកសត្វព្រៃ។
definition_en: A large area covered with many trees where wild animals live.
example_km: យើងត្រូវការពារព្រៃឈើ។
example_en: We must protect the forest.

hints.easy: It is a place in nature.
hints.medium: Full of tall trees where tigers and elephants live.
hints.strong: This 2-syllable compound starts with ព្រៃ.

definition_km: ទីដីខ្ពស់ធំជាងដីធម្មតា។
definition_en: A high natural landform rising above the surrounding land.
example_km: ភ្នំមានខ្យល់អាកាសបរិសុទ្ធ។
example_en: The mountain has fresh air.

hints.easy: It is a landform in nature.
hints.medium: Very tall rock and earth reaching high toward the sky.
hints.strong: This 1-syllable word starts with ភ្ន.

definition_km: ផ្លូវទឹកធំធម្មជាតិដែលហូរកាត់ដី។
definition_en: A large natural flowing stream of water.
example_km: ទូកកំពុងបើកលើទន្លេ។
example_en: A boat is moving on the river.

hints.easy: It is a place with lots of water.
hints.medium: A wide flowing body of water where boats travel.
hints.strong: This word contains subscript ្ល attached to ន.

notes: 2 spoken syllables (/tŭən.lei/), but ្ល attaches to ន—keep intact and do not split at ន្ល.

definition_km: លំហខាងលើផែនដី ដែលមានពពក ព្រះអាទិត្យ និងផ្កាយ។
definition_en: The space above the earth where clouds and the sun appear.
example_km: ថ្ងៃនេះមេឃស្រឡះស្អាត។
example_en: Today the sky is clear and bright.

hints.easy: Look up to see it.
hints.medium: Clouds, the sun, and stars appear here.
hints.strong: This 1-syllable word ends with ឃ.

khmer: ព្រះអាទិត្យ
definition_km: ផ្កាយភ្លឺធំនៅលើមេឃ ដែលផ្តល់ពន្លឺ និងកម្តៅដល់ផែនដី។
definition_en: The bright star in the sky that gives light and warmth.
example_km: ព្រះអាទិត្យរះនៅពេលព្រឹក។
example_en: The sun rises in the morning.

hints.easy: It shines brightly in the sky.
hints.medium: It gives us daylight and warmth during the day.
hints.strong: This compound begins with ព្រះ.

sources: Wiktionary: ព្រះអាទិត្យ

definition_km: ដំណក់ទឹកដែលធ្លាក់ចុះពីពពកលើមេឃ។
definition_en: Water droplets falling from clouds in the sky.
example_km: ភ្លៀងធ្លាក់ជួយឱ្យដើមឈើលូតលាស់។
example_en: Rain helps trees grow.

hints.easy: It is weather with water.
hints.medium: Water falling from dark clouds in the sky.
hints.strong: This 1-syllable word starts with ភ្ល.

definition_km: ធម្មជាតិ ទឹក ដី ខ្យល់ និងអ្វីៗដែលនៅជុំវិញយើង។
definition_en: The natural world and surroundings around us.
example_km: សិស្សរួមគ្នាថែរក្សាបរិស្ថាន។
example_en: Students work together to care for the environment.

hints.easy: It refers to the world around us.
hints.medium: Includes trees, water, air, and land we must protect.
hints.strong: Starts with ប and ends with ស្ថាន.

sources: Wiktionary: បរិស្ថាន
notes: Orthographic KCCs (ប-រិ-ស្ថាន) differ from spoken boundary (/paʔ.rəh.tʰaːn/); marked null pending teacher review.

definition_km: ទីកន្លែងសម្រាប់សិស្សមកសិក្សារៀនសូត្រ។
definition_en: A place where students go to learn.
example_km: ខ្ញុំទៅសាលារៀននៅពេលព្រឹក។
example_en: I go to school in the morning.

hints.easy: It is a place for learning.
hints.medium: Teachers and students meet here every weekday.
hints.strong: This 3-syllable word starts with សា.

definition_km: សន្លឹកក្រដាសចងជាក្បាល សម្រាប់អាន ឬសរសេរ។
definition_en: Bound pages used for reading or writing.
example_km: សិស្សបើកសៀវភៅអានមេរៀន។
example_en: The student opens a book to read the lesson.

hints.easy: It is a study item.
hints.medium: You turn its pages to read stories and lessons.
hints.strong: This 2-syllable word starts with សៀវ.

definition_km: ឧបករណ៍ប្រើទឹកថ្នាំសម្រាប់សរសេរ។
definition_en: An ink tool used for writing.
example_km: ខ្ញុំសរសេរដោយប្រើប៊ិចខៀវ។
example_en: I write using a blue pen.

hints.easy: It is a writing tool.
hints.medium: Uses ink to write on paper.
hints.strong: This 1-syllable word uses Triisap ៊ on ប.

definition_km: ឧបករណ៍សម្រាប់សរសេរ ឬគូរ និងអាចលុបបាន។
definition_en: A writing or drawing tool whose marks can be erased.
example_km: កូនក្មេងគូររូបដំរីដោយប្រើខ្មៅដៃ។
example_en: The kid draws an elephant using a pencil.

hints.easy: It is a classroom tool.
hints.medium: Used for writing and drawing, and you can erase it.
hints.strong: This 2-syllable compound ends with ដៃ.

definition_km: ផ្ទាំងក្តារនៅក្នុងថ្នាក់រៀន សម្រាប់គ្រូសរសេរមេរៀន។
definition_en: A classroom board where the teacher writes lessons.
example_km: គ្រូសរសេរអក្សរខ្មែរលើក្តារខៀន។
example_en: The teacher writes Khmer letters on the board.

hints.easy: It is found at the front of a classroom.
hints.medium: Teachers write lessons on it for everyone to see.
hints.strong: This 2-syllable compound starts with ក្តារ.

sources: Wiktionary: ក្តារខៀន

khmer: គ្រូបង្រៀន
definition_km: អ្នកដែលបង្ហាត់បង្រៀនចំណេះដឹងដល់សិស្ស។
definition_en: A person who teaches students at school.
example_km: គ្រូបង្រៀនពន្យល់មេរៀនយ៉ាងច្បាស់។
example_en: The teacher explains the lesson clearly.

hints.easy: A person who works at school.
hints.medium: Helps students learn to read and write.
hints.strong: This compound begins with គ្រូ.

sources: Wiktionary: គ្រូបង្រៀន
notes: Keep បង្រៀន intact; ្រ attaches as a subscript to ង.

definition_km: អ្នកដែលកំពុងសិក្សារៀនសូត្រនៅសាលារៀន។
definition_en: A learner who studies at school.
example_km: សិស្សប្រឹងប្រែងរៀនភាសាខ្មែរ។
example_en: The student tries hard to learn Khmer.

hints.easy: A person at school.
hints.medium: Listens to the teacher and studies lessons.
hints.strong: This 1-syllable word starts with សិ.

definition_km: គ្រឿងសង្ហារិមមានជើង និងផ្ទៃរាប សម្រាប់ដាក់សៀវភៅ ឬអាហារ។
definition_en: A flat-topped piece of furniture used for studying or eating.
example_km: សៀវភៅនៅលើតុ។
example_en: The book is on the desk.

hints.easy: It is furniture in a classroom or home.
hints.medium: You put your books and notebooks on it.
hints.strong: This very short 1-syllable word starts with ត.

definition_km: អគារសម្រាប់មនុស្ស និងគ្រួសាររស់នៅ។
definition_en: A building where a family lives.
example_km: ផ្ទះរបស់ខ្ញុំមានសួនផ្កាស្អាត។
example_en: My house has a pretty flower garden.

hints.easy: It is a place where people live.
hints.medium: Has a roof, doors, and rooms for a family.
hints.strong: This 1-syllable word ends with Reahmukh ះ.

definition_km: គ្រឿងសង្ហារិមសម្រាប់អង្គុយ។
definition_en: A seat for one person.
example_km: សូមអង្គុយលើកៅអីនេះ។
example_en: Please sit on this chair.

hints.easy: It is a piece of furniture.
hints.medium: You sit on it at a desk or table.
hints.strong: This 2-syllable word starts with កៅ.

definition_km: សន្ទះសម្រាប់បិទ ឬបើកផ្លូវចេញចូលផ្ទះ ឬបន្ទប់។
definition_en: A movable barrier used to open or close an entrance.
example_km: សិស្សបើកទ្វារចូលក្នុងថ្នាក់រៀន។
example_en: The student opens the door to enter the classroom.

hints.easy: Found at the entrance of a room or house.
hints.medium: You open it to walk inside—and unlock it in the maze!
hints.strong: This 1-syllable word starts with ទ្វ.

definition_km: ដី ឬសំណង់សម្រាប់មនុស្សដើរ និងយានជំនិះធ្វើដំណើរ។
definition_en: A path or street for walking and vehicles.
example_km: ផ្លូវទៅសាលារៀនមានដើមឈើច្រើន។
example_en: The road to school has many trees.

hints.easy: You travel along it outside.
hints.medium: Bicycles and cars drive on it.
hints.strong: This 1-syllable word starts with ផ្ល.

definition_km: ទីកន្លែងជួបជុំសម្រាប់ទិញ និងលក់ទំនិញ។
definition_en: A place where people buy and sell food and goods.
example_km: ម្តាយទិញត្រី និងបន្លែនៅផ្សារ។
example_en: Mother buys fish and vegetables at the market.

hints.easy: It is a busy place in town or the village.
hints.medium: People go here to buy fresh fruit, vegetables, and clothes.
hints.strong: This 1-syllable word starts with ផ្ស.

definition_km: អ្នកប្រកបរបរដាំដុះស្រូវ ដំណាំ និងចិញ្ចឹមសត្វ។
definition_en: A person who grows rice, crops, or raises animals.
example_km: កសិករធ្វើស្រែនៅរដូវវស្សា។
example_en: Farmers work in the rice fields during the rainy season.

hints.easy: It is an important job in Cambodia.
hints.medium: This person grows rice and vegetables for everyone.
hints.strong: This 3-syllable word starts with ក and ends with ករ.

definition_km: ឧបករណ៍សម្រាប់ប្រាប់ពេលវេលា ម៉ោង និងនាទី។
definition_en: A device that tells the time in hours and minutes.
example_km: ខ្ញុំមើលនាឡិកាមុនពេលទៅសាលារៀន។
example_en: I check the clock before going to school.

hints.easy: It is an everyday tool.
hints.medium: It has numbers and tells you what time it is.
hints.strong: This 3-syllable word starts with នា.
